sentence: I have been wait for the bus for an hour.
ruleVi: Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn: have/has been + V-ing.

sentence: She has be learning English since 2020.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc là has been + V-ing; sau has dùng been.

sentence: It have been raining since this morning.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ it dùng has been + V-ing.

sentence: How long are you studying here?
ruleVi: Hỏi việc kéo dài đến bây giờ: How long have you been + V-ing?

sentence: Minh is working here for three years.
ruleVi: Việc bắt đầu trong quá khứ, kéo dài đến nay (for three years): has been + V-ing.

sentence: We has been living in Saigon for ten years.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ we dùng have been + V-ing.

sentence: Why are your clothes wet? Have you been swim?
ruleVi: Have you been + V-ing? dùng để hỏi việc vừa kéo dài để lại dấu hiệu.

sentence: He has been fixed the car all morning.
ruleVi: Sau has been dùng V-ing để nói việc kéo dài: has been fixing.

sentence: I have been knowing her for years.
ruleVi: Động từ trạng thái như know không dùng thể tiếp diễn; dùng hiện tại hoàn thành: have known.

sentence: My mother has been cook since six o'clock.
